hook: 字根 vert/vers＝轉——人生遙控器專管轉向。
script: 風向一變就 divert 轉向；危險來了趕緊 avert 轉開。政策 revert 轉回舊制，野心家想 subvert 從底下推翻。性格 perverse 老愛反著轉；世界觀是宇宙的 universe，一封信是寫給你的 verse 轉過來的詩行。

members.senseAnchor: turn aside; turn away from; send on a course or in a direction different from the planned or intended one
members.zhGloss: 使轉向；轉移注意力；娛樂
members.speakLineEn: The anecdote diverted attention from the weak premise.
members.speakLineZh: 這則軼事把注意力從薄弱前提轉開。

members.senseAnchor: prevent the occurrence of; prevent from happening; turn away or aside
members.speakLineEn: Early warnings helped avert a larger crisis.
members.speakLineZh: 早期預警協助避免了更大危機。

related.synonyms: debar, forefend, forfend, obviate, deflect, avoid

members.senseAnchor: go back to a previous state; undergo reversion, as in a mutation
members.speakLineEn: Without oversight, practices may revert to old habits.
members.speakLineZh: 缺少監督時，做法可能轉回舊習慣。

members.speakLineEn: Satire can subvert official narratives without direct attack.
members.speakLineZh: 諷刺能在不直接攻擊下顛覆官方敘事。

members.senseAnchor: marked by a disposition to oppose and contradict; resistant to guidance or discipline
members.speakLineEn: A perverse reading ignores the plain sense of the text.
members.speakLineZh: 乖戾的解讀會忽略文本的平白意思。

related.synonyms: contrary, obstinate, wayward, depraved, perverted, reprobate

members.speakLineEn: The study claims validity across a broad universe of cases.
members.speakLineZh: 該研究宣稱在廣泛案例宇宙中皆有效。
members.vocabNote: 留在幽默庫作構詞／劇本用；暫不列入 GRE 難詞主庫，避免稀釋考點密度。

members.speakLineEn: A versatile method travels across disciplines.
members.speakLineZh: 多用途方法能跨領域旅行。
不利的誘因扭曲了通報。

members.speakLineEn: The anniversary essay revisited the founding debate.
members.speakLineZh: 週年紀念文重訪了創立時的辯論。
members.vocabNote: 留在幽默庫作構詞／劇本用；暫不列入 GRE 難詞主庫，避免稀釋考點密度。

members.speakLineEn: The controversy turned on how to define harm.
members.speakLineZh: 爭議聚焦在如何定義傷害。

members.speakLineEn: An introvert may still lead through careful writing.
members.speakLineZh: 內向者仍可透過審慎寫作領導。

reviewHooks: vert＝轉：divert 轉開、avert 避開、revert 轉回、subvert 底下翻轉
perverse＝故意反著來；universe＝轉成一整體的世界
pitfalls: avert（轉開／避免）≠ advert（注意／廣告相關）
subvert 是顛覆體制，不是單純『轉個彎』
